project.name: Boris Diff
project.summary: Boris Diff: League damage calculator; 'Build combos, compare damage, and theorycraft item builds'; champion picker currently lists Akali, Lux, Ahri, Katarina, Vayne, Jhin, Quinn and Locke with 'More champions coming soon' and a Discord vote for the next champion.
